title: What a roulette bet is really worth

probes.question: What does the expected value of a bet describe?
options: The average result if repeated many times

probes.question: True or false: a single-number roulette bet in American roulette has a negative expected value for the player.

image.alt: A wooden roulette wheel with red and black numbered pockets and a green zero, photographed from above on a dark background.

body.question: In American roulette (38 pockets), you bet $1 on a single number. It pays $35 if you win. On average, what happens to each $1 you bet?
body.reveal: You lose about 5 cents. A win has a 1 in 38 chance and pays $35, so the expected result is -$1 x 37/38 + $35 x 1/38 = -$1/19. Expected value is the average outcome if you could repeat the bet many times.
